high_level_description: This image is a vibrant and intricate digital artwork that appears to be shared on an Instagram Explore page. The artist's username, "risingthunderbird," is displayed at the top of the post, with an option to follow them. The central focus of the image is a surreal and psychedelic scene. At the center is a large, eye-like structure with concentric circles and a spiral pattern, reminiscent of a DNA strand or a cosmic vortex. The eye is set against a starry night sky, adding to the otherworldly atmosphere.
